ideas.description: May be empty. An empty week is information; a padded one is noise the selection call then has to wade through.

hook.description: The angle a post would take. Not a summary of the article — a summary is a link, and the owner does not need more links.

source_url.description: Must come from the search results, not from the model's memory.

cross_domain.description: True when the material is from outside the data field and only the hook transfers.
